title: harness: bash-uses-pwsh-guard (use PowerShell tool directly)
desc: Blocks Bash commands that call powershell.exe or pwsh.exe. PowerShell work must use the PowerShell tool, not Bash spawning it.
steps: SAFETY: Catches Bash commands matching 'powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe', 'powershell -', or 'pwsh -'. Spawning PowerShell from Bash adds a process layer, loses the PowerShell tool's UTF-8/permission handling, and is the anti-pattern.
SOLUTION: Use the PowerShell tool directly instead of 'Bash(powershell.exe -Command ...)'. The PowerShell tool is already available -- use it natively.
PREVENTION: Never chain powershell.exe or pwsh.exe inside a Bash command. If your task is PowerShell-native, use the PowerShell tool. Detail: wkappbot skill read wrapper-harness-integration
author: claude
